period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior period-end position. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year, as published in the bank's own 'Un-audited Balance Sheet' and 'Un-audited Profit and Loss Account' for the period ended 31 March 2023. SOLO/STANDALONE basis (header reads 'Mercantile Bank PLC.' / 'Mercantile Bank Limited' Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account with no 'and its Subsidiaries'/'Consolidated' qualifier; the same source PDF also contains an earlier CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account section headed 'Mercantile Bank PLC. and its Subsidiaries', which was correctly identified and NOT used, consistent with this bank's established SOLO reporting_basis). SOURCE PDF WAS A SCANNED IMAGE (0 lines extractable via pdftotext) -- recovered via OCR: rendered to PNG with pdftoppm at 250 DPI, then run through tesseract (--psm 6). Every balance-sheet and P&L subtotal was manually cross-checked against every internal arithmetic identity before being trusted -- balance-sheet identity (Total Assets = sum of 8 asset lines = Total Liabilities + Total Equity), Total Liabilities composition (Borrowings + Subordinated Bond + Perpetual Bond + Deposits + Other Liabilities), the full operating-income chain (Net Interest Income + Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income = Total Operating Income), the expense/provision/tax/net-profit chain, the appropriation chain (Net Profit + Retained Surplus b/f = Appropriations + Retained Surplus c/f, cross-tied to the Balance Sheet's own Surplus-in-P&L line), Off-Balance-Sheet composition, and EPS (Net Profit / (Paid-up Capital / 10 par value)). This redundant-arithmetic approach caught and corrected specific OCR digit-substitution errors (documented per-period below) before any figure was accepted into this dataset; periods where a figure could not be confidently resolved this way were left as reported without forcing a correction. Two digit-substitution OCR errors were found and corrected via redundant arithmetic (both a leading '1' misread as '4', a recurring pattern in this scan batch): Commission/exchange/brokerage income read as 4,105,397,628 (raw OCR) but must be 1,105,397,628 -- the raw reading made Total operating income overstate the printed total by exactly 3,000,000,000; and 'Profit/(Loss) before provision' read as 4,404,170,170 (raw OCR) but must be 1,404,170,170 -- confirmed as Total operating income (corrected) minus Total operating expenses, and consistent with Total profit before taxes tying out from that corrected figure. Both corrections were independently reconfirmed against the FY2024-Q1 filing's own Jan-23-to-Mar-23 comparative column (see quarterly/2024_Q1.json), which reproduces both corrected values exactly.
